value.rationale: The natural transport objective is mean absorption into a localized hub sink from an initially localized peripheral excitation; the theorem establishes the exact universal efficiency law, sharp two-rate tradeoffs and sqrt(m) optimum, and a singular switch from partial to complete absorption. These resolve physical graph-kinetics questions rather than arbitrary finite tables.
